Director of Business Intelligence
North American Blueberry Council and U.S. Highbush Blueberry Council
Folsom, CA
Annual Salary: $150,000 – $175,000 DOE/DOQ


The North American Blueberry Council (NABC) and the U.S. Highbush Blueberry Council (USHBC) are seeking a strategic and collaborative leader to serve as their next Director of Business Intelligence. This is an exciting opportunity to lead and advance a growing Data and Insights Program that provides critical data and analysis to the Councils and the broader blueberry industry. The Director oversees the systems, processes, contractors, and external partners that transform complex information into actionable insights, while building strong relationships with growers and industry stakeholders to understand their needs and encourage timely, reliable data sharing. The ideal candidate combines exceptional project management and analytical thinking with the ability to see the big picture, communicate the story behind the data, and leverage emerging technologies to continually enhance the program. Help shape decisions that move the blueberry industry forward; apply today!


View the full recruitment brochure here: https://indd.adobe.com/view/8c8bb6ed-83d6-4d4c-9925-1c6f15e1264a


SALARY AND BENEFITS
Annual Salary: $150,000 – $175,000 DOE/DOQ, PLUS an attractive benefits package.


HOW TO APPLY

For first consideration, apply by November 30, 2026 by completing an application and attaching your cover letter and resume at: https://wbcp.applicantpool.com/jobs/1338679-300215.html


View the WBCP Job Board: https://wbcpinc.com/job-board/


SAVE THE DATES

Round one virtual interviews will take place the week of January 11, 2027. Finalists will move forward to round two in-person interviews on January 22, 2027. Selected candidates must be available for both dates.


QUESTIONS?

Please contact your recruiter, Shani Pearce, with any questions:

• shani@wbcpinc.com
• 541-664-0376 (Direct)
• 866-929-9227 (Toll-Free)

NABC is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.
